messages:
nina (Docs): FYI I opened a PR for the upcoming notes: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/498. Top items: routing feature blurb, canary known-issue, Python SDK streaming example needs to change, and i18n keys for the telemetry copy. Please help triage.

ryan (PM): Solid. Order of work: 1) short public blurb for release notes, 2) known-issue with repro + mitigation link, 3) update snippet + compatibility note, 4) export i18n strings.

jas (Eng): I'll draft the repro steps for the canary latency regression. Quick summary: under bursty QPS the canary can see elevated p95 due to KV-cache churn and routing thrash. Will paste minimal repro.

nina (Docs): Need a one-line changelog sentence and a longer paragraph for the full release notes page. Also want a tiny callout that points readers to the runbook.

leo (DevEx): Streaming snippet: prior docs use client.chat.stream(..., stream=True). New SDK (>=2.1.0) uses chat.stream() iterator. Proposed minimal snippet:
```python
resp = client.chat.stream(model=\"kestrel-v1\", input=prompt)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.delta, end=\"\")
```
Add a compatibility note: \"If you are on SDK <=2.0.x, use the legacy streaming API (see below).\"

maya (L10N): Please list the exact strings to extract and their file paths. We need keys by EOD to schedule translations.

nina (Docs): Strings to extract:
- \"Adaptive routing telemetry enabled — learn more\"
- \"Known issue: elevated canary latency under burst\"
- \"Requires SDK >= 2.1.0 for new streaming API\"
Paths: docs/content/release-notes/0.9.x/*.md and docs/src/snippets/python/streaming.md
Add to tracker: https://l10n.internal/tasks/1799

jas (Eng): Repro steps (minimal):
1) Deploy canary at 10% traffic.
2) Emit 200 QPS with 95th pct token lengths ~512 for 3 minutes.
3) Observe canary p95 latency ~30-50% higher than dedicated due to cold KV cache; routing thrash amplifies.
Mitigation: pin traffic to dedicated or pre-warm prefixes. Link: docs/runbooks/canary-latency.md

legal-bot: Telemetry copy suggestion: \"We collect aggregated routing telemetry (latency and error rates) to improve service quality. No user text payloads are stored in this telemetry.\"

nina (Docs): I'll add that as a footnote to the telemetry section.

leo (DevEx): Legacy snippet for <=2.0.x:
```python
# legacy streaming
res = client.chat.create(model=\"kestrel-v1\", input=prompt, stream=True)
for chunk in res:
    print(chunk)
```
Note: behavior and chunk shape differ.

maya (L10N): Keys queued, ETA 48h for translated strings once keys are in.

ci-bot: docs-ci: build passed for branch release-notes/0.9.3 (job #1502) :white_check_mark:

nina (Docs): Thanks all. Plan: I will update PR with legal text and revised snippets, add i18n keys, and merge tomorrow morning after thumbs. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.

jas (Eng): :thumbsup:

leo (DevEx): :thumbsup: snippet updated

maya (L10N): :thumbsup: keys added

nina (Docs): Closing thread here; will post merge time in #docs when done.
